0.content:
Lisa calls Jean a gifted and dedicated leader whose hard work makes even Lisa want to help. Jean says that when Lisa is around, she always has peace of mind, and she looks to Lisa for potions to keep her awake. Lisa was at Jean's side when the Traveler first came to headquarters (1.0) and went to the Temple of the Lion because "Jean trusts me". She helped organise the Knights' party for Jean during her day off. She sometimes greets people sleepily with "Good morning, Jean" before realising who it is.

Lisa worries that Jean will burn out. During a limited-time 2.5 event she dragged Jean to Angel's Share, ordered a Love Poem ("medium, extra sweet") and told the Traveler that Jean is the only person she knows who needs to be taught how to relax. At the 1.4 Windblume Festival (limited event), Jean took Lisa on patrol and forbade electrocuting drunks; Lisa insisted the last one was practically begging for it. Jean gave her an extended paid vacation in 3.4.

1.content:
Razor was raised by wolves in Wolvendom and brought into contact with the Knights by Varka. Lisa taught him how to use his Electro elemental energy and never expected him to master it so fast. He calls her "Teacher" and sums her up as "Lisa lightning makes the sky black. She is strong. She is scary." Her voice-over has her coaxing him to combat practice ("good boy!") only for him to bolt.

During the 3.1 Weinlesefest (limited event), a letter from Varka, written in the far north and carried home by Mika, told Lisa that a box of Razor's parents' mementos sat in Jean's office and it was time he had it. Lisa worried he might shut himself off from his teacher if upset, and asked the Traveler and Paimon, whom he trusts as friends, to tell him. She explained the Thousand-Wind Wine they found and treated helping him as one more tutoring session.

2.content:
Lisa studied for two years in the Spantamad Darshan under the sage Cyrus, who calls her his best student in two hundred years. She graduated, then went straight home. Officially the reason was unknown. Privately: she saw raving-mad scholars in the forests and powerful sages wasting away on advisory councils, and asked how much one must sacrifice for the deepest knowledge. Unwilling to pay, she left and has stopped short of taking things too seriously ever since.

In a limited-time 3.4 event she returned to Sumeru on an extended paid vacation, in time for her Darshan's reunion. Her old classmate Gafoor, now a professor, tried to win her back: she could have been a Herbad by now. She refused. Cyrus knows exactly why she left and would never ask, she said, and "the price of seeking wisdom is no longer something I'm willing to pay." Looking after a library is important work too. She told the Traveler that Cyrus's big projects reached for wisdom beyond mortal understanding and mostly failed, and asked them to keep that between them. She prefers work that starts after 10:00 in the morning, with afternoon tea.

3.content:
Lisa took a liking to the Traveler at their first meeting and has called them "cutie" ever since. She offers to be their teacher, master or friend, and plays at making them her "star pupil" with a forehead kiss in one voice line. She is curious why the Traveler can use the elements without a Vision. In her Serenitea Pot dialogue she says they are special to her and that she does not count the effort when it is for them. This affectionate teasing is her character; canon gives them no romance.

In the Prologue the two cleared the Temple of the Lion together. In her Story Quest she took the Traveler along to collect overdue books, let them keep the recovered storybook as its "custodian", and gave them a Teyvat Travel Guide. In Sumeru (3.4) she was impressed that they had handled a crisis involving the God of Wisdom; Nahida's mind-reading showed her privately thinking how much the Traveler had grown.

4.comment: Lisa: The Library and Overdue Books
4.content:
The library at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters is, Lisa says, the largest in northern Teyvat, and she has read every book in it. She signs books in and out at the counter like a languid cat. Every library copy carries an elemental marker so it can be traced. In her Story Quest (Tempus Fugit Chapter, 1.0) the Traveler wanted a travel guide; finding it overdue, Lisa went door to door collecting books, and learned from Donna that one had been stolen. They followed its elemental trail to a ruin. There a Cryo Abyss Mage named Emery claimed the book held "the secret" and refused to give it back; Lisa electrocuted him on the spot. The book was an ordinary copy of The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies.

Kaeya warns everyone that a late book once left his arm numb. Fischl returns books three days early. Lisa recommends the alchemy workshop upstairs to friends, but asks them to knock first. Hertha will not let her use the disused interrogation room as a private workshop. By the Serenitea Pot era she notes that more people return books on time.

5.content:
Klee says Lisa is the best because she sneaks her treats at the workshop. Lisa once refused to let Klee use the workshop for experiments, and Klee sulked for a day before happily going off to play. During a limited-time 1.6 event, Lisa helped Klee and the Traveler read the Dodo-King's summons. She found hidden elemental script on the letter, had the Traveler copy it with Elemental Sight, and recognised the Golden Apple Archipelago from sailors' legends in her books.

In a limited-time 4.1 event, invasive Sumeru fish appeared in Cider Lake and Klee had spotted them. Lisa invented the game Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure, based on a student game called Shroomsplosion, and ordered grilled fish and desserts from Good Hunter. This kept Klee happily in the city while the Investigation Team dealt with the fish.

6.content: When Lisa joined the Knights, Grand Master Varka meant to make her Captain of the 8th Company. Its Field Officer, Nymph, resented an academic taking such a high post. Kaeya proposed a practice bout of magic. After two minutes Lisa graciously declined, saying Nymph "manifestly possesses the requisite ability". For a year Nymph sent Varka referral letters naming only Lisa Minci; Varka began handing them to her directly, and she always found an excuse. The company would surely have been stronger under her, but she judged that much power superfluous and risky for her in a way few could appreciate. Above all, extra danger meant extra work.

7.content: Cyno studied under the same Spantamad sage as Lisa, and she calls him her junior. She has barely kept in touch with the Akademiya beyond courtesy letters to her teachers, but notes that Cyno leads an action-packed life. Cyno says that as General Mahamatra he has seen many tragedies among over-zealous scholars, so her decision makes sense to him. In the manga, her letter to their teacher brought Cyno to Mondstadt, where he sealed the power inside Collei. During the limited-time 3.5 Windblume Festival she greeted him in the library as "my underclassman". She teased that he took after Cyrus's wit and eccentricities while she took after his poetic phrasing. Cyno considers her as much part of Cyrus's family as he is.

8.content: In the official manga, set before the Traveler arrived, the young Collei came to Mondstadt carrying a dangerous power. Lisa compiled the Knights' reports on the Black Fire Incident and sought her old teacher's help with an ancient script in a Fatui file, which brought Cyno. Before Collei left with him for Sumeru, Lisa helped her write a thank-you letter to Amber. They are still pen pals. Lisa notices Collei trying out new words in every letter and credits her "wonderful and warmhearted master". Collei laughs, relieved, on learning Lisa calls the Traveler "cutie" too. In 3.4 she regretted not yet having had time to visit Collei in Gandharva Ville, though she planned to leave Sumeru from there.

9.content: When the reborn dragon Durin first came to live in Mondstadt, Jean was not sure what to do with him, so Lisa stepped in as his tutor. If she could handle a boy raised by wolves, she reasoned, one who is part dragon should be easy. She taught him to read and write and to keep quiet in the library. Seeing that he longed for friends but hesitated, she gave him an extracurricular assignment: go out and observe how Mondstadters interact. He failed to finish it. She did not blame him, because she could see he had already found his place among people.

10.comment: Lisa: Albedo, Sucrose and the Alchemy Workshop
10.content: Lisa's other duty is keeping the Knights stocked with potions, done in the alchemy workspace above the library that she shares with Albedo. She praises Albedo as an alchemist who always has a solution, and adds that he is easy on the eyes. Albedo values her perspectives but wonders what hidden reason keeps someone so talented in a librarian's job. She warns people not to startle the shy Sucrose; Sucrose wonders how Lisa keeps advising her on the core of research she has never seen. Lisa spent two weeks and an enormous budget building the Special Heating Cauldron (time-delay heating, semi-automatic ingredient insertion, temperature control). It can do any precision heating job in two lever pulls, and mostly keeps her tea warm.

11.content: When the Traveler first reached the Knights' headquarters, Jean introduced Lisa as the resident Librarian. Dvalin's rampage had left Mondstadt's Ley Lines "like a yarn ball in the paws of a kitten", and Lisa joked she was one elemental particle away from a full-blown breakout. Her detection magic showed that Stormterror was drawing power from the abandoned Four Winds' temples. She and the Traveler cleared the Temple of the Lion and destroyed the crystal there, with Lisa fighting alongside as a trial character. She was pleased when the crisis was resolved.
